purpose: Pass 31: four-row parallel official and first-party verification while the preserved V53 browser-acceptance task remains unclaimed. Same task and attempt retained; no second runner, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication.

method.policy: Primary auction pages, current first-party operator/service pages, GOV.UK Companies House, CQC/NHS, Charity Commission and local-government service routes only. Search snippets and directories are not promoted. Company, registration or service-page status does not prove executed lease, legal completion or parcel geometry.

rows.address: Millennium Medical Centre, 121 Weoley Castle Road, Birmingham, B29 5QD
rows.resolved_fact: The auction page records a 15-year medical-centre lease from November 2023. The NHS profile still marks the GP surgery closed, while CQC continues to publish legal registration, exact contact details and Our Health Partnership as provider. The NHS DSP Toolkit records a 2025-26 standards-met publication on 25 June 2026 for organisation M85023 at the exact address. These records strengthen current organisational and regulatory identity but do not prove that patient-facing GP services are open or that the lease remains unaffected.

rows.address: Regent House, 144-148 York Road, Hartlepool, TS26 9DU
rows.resolved_fact: The auction page separates the former bank, cafe and dance-studio interests and records the cafe term ending 23 June 2026. Karen Liddle Studios continues to publish classes, registration and current hours at 144-148 York Road, while Companies House records active KLSD C.I.C. at the exact address. No current first-party cafe operator or executed cafe renewal was obtained, so the dance-studio identity is strong but the cafe and full mixed-occupation position remain open.

rows.address: 14-18 High Street, Heathfield, East Sussex, TN21 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: The auction page remains historical. ACCESS GYM LTD is active, its first-party site publishes the exact Heathfield premises, proposed opening hours and founders memberships but still says it is preparing to open. Its membership app was updated on 10 June 2026 and identifies the exact address. This supports an active launch and digital operating stack, not a verified physically open gym or an executed assignment from the historical Factory Shop interest.

The auction page records a historical CHARIS tenancy to June 2027. CHARIS Refugees' current first-party contact and Welcome Hub pages publish 16-17 Hammet Street as its headquarters and Taunton Welcome Hub. The Charity Commission and Somerset Council independently publish the exact address and current opening/service schedule. Current site occupation and service identity are therefore resolved at address level, but the executed occupational lease, any assignment between entities, legal completion and exact freehold title remain unread.
